justifications.durability: The marker is a durable machine-readable block written into each committed receipt beside the value it annotates, so a reader sees the retirement without leaving the file, and the driver is idempotent (an existing dimensions_provenance block is preserved rather than replaced). Held below full for two reasons, both inherited in shape from the predecessor node. There is no guard that a later edit cannot silently drop the marker, and no negative control falsifies the marker's presence: the reviewed run's write paths contain no test file and it declared none. And the sweep that is offered as the completeness proof tests only whether the substring 'dimensions_provenance' appears anywhere in a file, so a value outside its enumerated set is invisible to it (the 2560 class below).
justifications.evidence: The substance is independently reproducible and I reproduced it. A path-keyed walk of every numeric value in the fifteen changed JSONs between base d1adce6cb and head 4d3e0554 reads 68241 numeric paths with 0 changed and 0 missing. Every one of the 21 added provenance blocks carries current_derived_value_for_this_layout equal to traced_polygon_vertex_capacity(straight) (148/150/152/158 for atomic capacities 20/22/24/30) and names the retiring revision f7fefbd7, which resolves to 'refactor(equilibrium): size the traced polygon capacity to its realised layout'. Base 0 -> head 1 (solve-memory-300) and 0 -> 3 (base-memory) occurrences of dimensions_provenance reproduce the marker's addition. The whole-tree sweep over tracked docs/figures reproduces: 37 files carry a quoted exact_support_capacity, exactly 34 of them hold a value in the swept set {3072,3840,2816}, and all 34 read marked with zero unmarked. But three reported figures do not reconcile with the tree. The commit body and fragment state the diff is '399 insertions' where git reports 823 for df8f2989b and 894 for base..head; 399 is the fifteen-receipt JSON subset only. The fragment states three layouts where the artifact marks four. And 'zero unmarked' holds only inside an enumerated target set that omits the swept value 2560 = 20 x 128, which this node itself marks in three files (base-memory, complete-memory, final-memory) yet leaves unmarked in two sibling receipts it swept past (below).
justifications.fit: The change sits in the docs/figures receipt tree it maintains, reuses the predecessor annotator and the predecessor provenance form, and ships one focused driver plus a build-evidence fragment. Commit subjects are conventional and both carry bodies; no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no AI attribution appears in any commit message, filename, symbol or comment (independently grepped). The driver docstring states the mechanism (spline_chain_samples_per_chord plus atomic_support_capacity; the swept product and its retiring revision as provenance data) and adds no abstraction beyond the one context arm. The one deviation the worker flagged (a context-mapping arm for the single receipt that records its dimensions under dimension_context with renamed fields) is necessary and minimal.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The change marks the retired swept exact_support_capacity historical exactly where the driving followup f-ecq-memory-identification-swept-product names it: the fifteen committed receipts under cut-cell-current-attribution/clip-quadrature (four) and exact-clip-memory (eleven) each gain a dimensions_provenance block naming the retiring revision f7fefbd7, quoting the swept expression atomic_support_capacity * spline_chain_samples_per_chord, and stating the current derived bound 128 + atomic_support_capacity. Twenty-one blocks land across the fifteen files, every recorded number is left intact and every file parses. Held below full because the marker driver and its fragment describe three layouts (152/158/150) while the artifact actually marks four distinct layouts (148 = 128 + 20, 150, 152, 158), and because the fragment's universal claim that every receipt here carries a block is literally false for two sibling receipts in the same declared directory (below).
justifications.scope_discipline: The landed diff is eighteen files, every one inside a declared write path: the fifteen data receipts under docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/{clip-quadrature,exact-clip-memory}/, the evidence fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/exact-clip-moment-quadrature/, and the driver plus its receipt under docs/figures/exact-clip-moment-quadrature/ecq-mark-cut-cell-capacity-receipts/. No module and no test file is touched, so there is no code surface to regress; the diff is purely additive (894 insertions, 0 deletions). The driver reuses the predecessor annotator unchanged and adds only the one context arm its single dimension_context receipt requires.

notes: The reviewed node is a documentation-provenance change with no code arm: it marks the retired swept exact_support_capacity historical in the fifteen cut-cell receipts and leaves every recorded number intact. The substance is sound and independently verified (empty numeric diff over 68241 paths, correct arithmetic on all 21 blocks, a valid revision anchor, and a sweep that reproduces 34 marked / 0 unmarked for its enumerated set). Three evidence imprecisions and one scope gap keep the score at 86. (1) The sweep's target set {3072,3840,2816} omits the swept value 2560, so two requested-500 receipts in the node's own declared directory carry the retired product with no marker and the fragment's 'every receipt here ... carries a block' is false. None of these changes a recorded numeric value or lands outside the declared scope, and the diff is purely additive on eighteen in-scope files. The node's own deviation note (a context-mapping arm for the one dimension_context receipt) is necessary and minimal.
